irregularities.title: Beat writer David Furones is attributed across 2 clubs (MIA, ARI)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed David Furones (South Florida Sun Sentinel) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.
